messages:
Maya Chen: Dropping a fresh dark-mode exploration for the Dashboard Overview. Main pain points: chart series distinguishability, code snippet legibility in the side drawer, and the legend compact layout on small screens. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzz (preview). Please review for a11y and mobile shrink.

Liam O'Neill: Nice work. Immediate flag: two line series (teal #2ec4b6 and green #38b000) are too close at small widths  contrast + hue. Also legend tiny text is 12px/400 on a 16px baseline  should be 13-14 for readability.

Sasha Patel: On inline code I see tokens collapsing with the background. Suggest token palette tweaks: keyword #8be9ff, fn-name #bde3a8, string #ffd99e, punctuation #9aa6b2. And add a 1px inner stroke to inline code containers for separation: rgba(255,255,255,0.04).

Tom Reyes: Interaction/accessibility notes: legend toggles need keyboard focus visible (not just hover). Use a 2px focus halo with color token --focus-ring (recommend #ffffff29). Legend items should be reachable via tab and have aria-pressed states. Also expand hit targets to 28px minimum on mobile.

Liam O'Neill: Proposed accessible series palette (color-blind aware):
```css
--series-1: #4ea8ff; /* blue */
--series-2: #ffb36b; /* warm orange */
--series-3: #c7b3ff; /* lavender */
--series-4: #7ef0c7; /* mint */
--legend-text: #e9f3ff;
```
All aim for >=4.5:1 on --bg-dark (#0c0f12).

ContrastBot: Auto-audit results: old teal vs bg => 3.1:1 (FAIL). proposed --series-2 (#ffb36b) vs bg => 5.4:1 (PASS). legend-text vs bg => 6.9:1 (PASS). focus ring current token fails contrast.

Sasha Patel: Regarding charts: add dashed pattern option for one-off series that are still low-contrast for users relying on color alone. Line patterns + shape markers help. Also consider a high-contrast mode toggle in user settings that swaps to bolder strokes and higher-sat tokens.

Maya Chen: Good suggestion, Sasha. For the compact legend on mobile I propose stacked chips with color swatch left, label middle, and an icon-only toggle right. Font 14px semibold for better tap readability.

Tom Reyes: Tooltip copy: change "Hide" to "Toggle series visibility" for clarity. Also aria-labels should include series name + "toggle visibility". Ex: aria-label="Toggle visibility for Request Latency".

Liam O'Neill: I'll add the token JSON and a small preview script that generates legend contrast matrix SVGs for QA. ETA ~40m.

Maya Chen: Thanks. I'll update the Figma tokens and add notes for QA about keyboard nav and mobile hit targets. Planning to ship as a micro release after verification.

ContrastBot: Follow-up after token update: all series colors pass contrast thresholds. Suggested focus halo: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18) on dark bg  PASS. Mobile hit targets flagged as 24px min, adjust to 28px.

Sasha Patel: Updated the Figma components to include dashed-line variant and the stacked mobile legend. Left comments with token names and pattern IDs.

Maya Chen: Great. I'll open a PR with the theme JSON, CSS utilities for focus/hitbox, and the copy tweak. Will tag UX and QA. Closing thread once PR is green. :rocket:
